prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” attorney for every car‑accident case — the right lawyer depends on your injuries, fault issues, insurance limits, whether you need a trial lawyer, and how you prefer to work with counsel. I can help you find the best match. A few quick questions first:

- Where in Chicago are you located (zip or neighborhood)?
- How serious are your injuries (minor, ongoing treatment, hospitalization, permanent)?
- Were you partly at fault or is fault disputed?
- Has any insurance company already made an offer?
- Do you need someone who will go to trial if needed?
- Any language preferences or scheduling constraints?

What I can do right away
- Give you a short list of highly regarded Chicago personal‑injury firms that handle car accidents and explain why they’re respected.
- Pull ratings, recent case results, AV/peer ratings, and contact info.
- Provide a script and checklist for free initial consultations.

What to look for in the “best” car‑accident lawyer
- Significant experience with car‑accident claims and serious injury cases.
- Trial experience (if you may need to litigate).
- Good track record of settlements/verdicts and client references.
- Clear contingency fee terms and transparency about costs.
- Strong communication (responsive and explains strategy).
- Good peer reviews/ratings (Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers, Martindale‑Hubbell).
- No disciplinary history with the Illinois Attorney Registration & Disciplinary Commission.

Examples of well‑known Chicago plaintiff firms (good starting points)
- Clifford Law Offices — national reputation handling serious car‑accident and wrongful‑death cases.
- Corboy & Demetrio — long history in catastrophic injury litigation.
- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard — handles personal injury and car‑accident claims.

(If you want, I’ll research more firms and individual attorneys with up‑to‑date ratings and recent verdicts/settlements.)

Questions to ask at an initial (usually free) consult
- How long have you practiced personal injury law and what percentage is car accidents?
- Have you handled cases like mine? Can you give examples of results?
- Will you handle my case personally or will it be assigned to another lawyer/associate?
- What is your fee and what costs might be deducted from my recovery?
- How long do you expect resolution to take?
- How will you communicate progress?

If you’d like, tell me the answers to the questions above (location, injury severity, etc.) and I’ll create a tailored short list of top Chicago attorneys with contact info and recent case results.
